searchText: I want to thank everyone involved with the ethereum blockchain. I used to code and lost the passion. I was involved in the IRC scene so I coded mIRC and helped with iRCD servers. My skills are limited to HTML, & some python. I found a new passion with ether. I plan on practicing my python skills & learning Solidity and Java (C if possible).. I’m super interested and passionate about smart contracts and NFTs.. I’d love for this to be my job someday, but I’m the meantime I work in insurance - I’m trying to get them to understand the logic of using smart contracts for insurance policies .. ANYWAY.. THANK YOU!! <@&595685821026271242> (conversation above) Def should make Micah a mod 😅 <@301186049323958275> do you want to be one 😛? I don't have any particular desire for such power, but if you all need help from Asia time zone I don't mind. What is the conventional "private key does not exists for this address" address? 0xdeadbeef? 0x0000000000000000dead? Anything that is obviously human generated. All same number, funny words spelled out with hex, UTF-8 encoding of your favorite 32 character phrase, etc. wasn't mIRC coded in C/C++? I think things might get a little crazy as we get closer toward the end of the year. Is there room for further blocksize increases or is the idea that "smart" blocksize by EIP1559 will handle any further load? I think that total altcoin marketcap might reach $4T around New Years Eve. Thats a 4x from here. Pretty wild if true Price comments aside, and please refrain from those in this server, <@456226577798135808>, the blocksize could still be increased after 1559. Right after London, the max block size will be 30m and the average will still be ~15m. There is always a cost in increasing the block size (state growth), but if the community feels the benefits outweigh them, it could be increased. is anyone concerned about a feedback loop where the fee burning becomes so significant that it creates an ETH shortage, which causes the price to go up, which generates media attention, which draws in more users, which raises fee burning even further, which creates a bigger shortage which generates even more media attention... so on There are still 2 ETH block rewards being generated in each block. I doubt burned fees will be higher than 2 eth. So it's not completely deflationary. This is there reason there is a gas *price*. The fiat price of ETH doesn't affect how much gas is used by a transaction, but it can affect the gas *price*. For example, if you send a 21000 txn, you may pay a gas price of 100 gwei if ETH is 2000$. If ETH was 20000$ instead, you could pay a gas price of 10 gwei instead and still pay the same USD-denominated fee. it would be interesting to backtest wether fees in terms of ETH go down when the exchange rate goes up and vice versa They can: because of DeFi I suspect fees are more correlated with price volatility than absolute price Things are gonna get completely out of control imo. People chasing that percievied free yield from PoS + people losing their minds over the fee burning number going up. + defi and nft potentially popping off. Its like the perfect storm. im scared in other news Newegg stock went up 100% today you know what i mean but it is what it is I'd second this nomination, its weird that Micah doesn't at least have a colored name. Is there a way to make the graveyard read only? let me see I might have just accomplished that. can you test? Thanks!
